detail.longDescription: Human approval binds nothing unless the executor compares what was approved with what runs. Loopjacking (arXiv, Sep 17): in Agno AgentOS 2.5.6 to 3.0.9, after an admin approves a tool call, a user with only agents:run can continue the run with the same call ID and new arguments; nothing checks them against the approved record. Same shape in LangGraph Agent Server 0.7.5 to 0.14.0 via message.command.update. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2609.21081 # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # LangGraph
